crate.package: jacs-core, jacs-media, jacs, jacs-binding-core, jacs-mcp, jacs-cli, jacs-mcp-compat, jacs-cli-compat, jacs-wasm, jacs-mobile, jacsnpm, jacspy, jacsgo, jacs-duckdb, jacs-postgresql, jacs-redb, jacs-surrealdb
platforms: portable Rust and isolated native compatibility crates; storage backends
crate.evidence: All 17 registry archives match the source-bound attested candidate checksums. The checksum manifest and both SPDX inventories pass hosted GitHub attestation verification. A clean registry consumer passes in CI; 13 SDK envelope/media tests also pass against the actual registry packages.

cli.evidence: All five CLI archives, checksum files and SPDX inventory pass exact public-asset and hosted GitHub attestation verification. The published macOS arm64 binary passes PQ signing/verification, custody, rotation and verify-only MCP tests.

platforms: browser source build; release package unavailable
wasm.evidence: Candidate browser, checksum and security gates passed, but first publication failed with npm EOTP. The bootstrap credential needs create-package write access and CI 2FA bypass; trusted publishing and credential removal follow successful publication. No npm release is claimed.

npm.evidence: The exact registry tarball matches its source-bound attested SHA-256 candidate checksum. Registry signatures/provenance, CJS/ESM PQ signing, tamper rejection, public exports, signing-input helpers and installed CLI checks pass; the durable SBOM is attested.

python.evidence: Five wheels and the source distribution match the source-bound attested candidate checksums and all six pass PEP 740 verification. Published-wheel checks pass on Python 3.10–3.14 after index propagation; fresh macOS PQ signing, tamper rejection and human-approval proof checks pass.

go.registry: Go module proxy and GitHub Releases
go.evidence: The semantic Go module tag and four native libraries are public. All 12 exact release assets pass checksum and hosted attestation verification. External consumers pass on all four targets; a fresh macOS arm64 consumer also passes after moving the build tree and clearing its environment.
